FORM NO. 3
G. 4000 11 37

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.... ....
S. 1, Special Branch,
REPORT    Date January 22, 1938.

Subject (in full). G. McLean

Made by. D.S. McKeown    Forwarded by C. Crawford

G. McLean (British), formerly residing at
206 North Szechuen Road is now staying at the Salvation
Army hostel, Amoy Road, together with his father
A. McLean. Neither has any permanent employment, and
the son earns a little money by giving English lessons
to Chinese.

D.C. (Special Branch).    McKeown.
                          D. S.

From
HEADQUARTERS.
SHANGHAI VOLUNTEER CORPS.
Shanghai, 14th January, 1938.

R P: 111/63.
To Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Subject: EQUIPMENT (BRITISH)
MCLEAN G.

The above-mentioned was a member of "B" Company,
S.V.C., and I would be grateful if you could inform me
of his present whereabouts in order that his rifle may
be collected from him.
His last known address was 206 North Szechuen Road.
Thanking you for any assistance you may be able to
give me.

W. Alexander Cat[illegible]
Colonel,
Commanding Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

TWC

January 22 38.

Commandant,
Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

G. McLean: Ref.111/63.

In reply to your note of 14th January, 1938,
I have to inform you that G. McLean (British) is now
staying at the Salvation Army Hostel, Amoy Road.

(Signed) J. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

Shanghai, 19th October, 1937.

Ref: 111/45
（印：POLICE REGISTRY 8257）
To Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Dear Sir,

Subject: S.V.C. FIREARMS AND PROPERTY,-
J.A. THOMAS.

The above is an emergency recruit of the Transport Company
S.V.C. and is in possession of 6" Webley Revolver No. 190.
As all firearms are being collected into Headquarters, I
would be grateful if you could inform me of his present
address.
His last known residence was - 55 Kinnear Road.

W. Maclean.
Captain,
Staff Officer,
Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

（批：D.S. Henchman. C 19/10）
（批：19/10）

FORM NO. 3

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch
REPORT

File No....................
S. B. REGISTRY
No. 636 Station, 257
Date December 25. 1937. 37

Subject Letter from S.V.C. Headquarters regarding the whereabouts of
one Mr. H.O. THORPE.

Made by D.S. Mischenko. Forwarded by N. Medvedeff D.S.I.

With reference to the contents of the attached communi-
cation from S.V.C. Headquarters regarding the whereabouts
of Mr. H.O. THORPE, I have to report that this individual
can be located during the evenings at Room No. 7, No. 348
Rue Bourgeat.
Whilst he has no permanent abode it is known that
he sleeps nearly every night at the address indicated
above and any communication addressed to him c/o of this
address will reach him.

D. Mischenko.
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（批：abbr.
26/12）

December 27 37.

Staff Officer,
S. V. C.
Dear Sir,

Ref.111/58 : H.O. Thorpe.

With reference to your letter dated 22nd
December, 1937, I have to inform you that H.O. Thorpe
has no permanent abode but may be found at Room No.7,
No. 348 Rue Bourgeat where he sleeps nearly every
night. Any communication addressed to him c/o of
this address will reach him.

Yours faithfully,

(Sd) □ □ □ □ □ □.
Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

From
HEADQUARTERS.
SHANGHAI VOLUNTEER CORPS.
Shanghai, 22nd December, 1937.

Ref: 111/58.
To The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Dear Sir,

M.O. THORPE.

I would be very grateful if you could furnish me
with the private address of the above-mentioned, who was
a member of the Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

He was until recently employed by the Yee Tsoong
Tobacco Company.

This information is required in order that his
firearms and kit may be collected.

Thanking you for any assistance you may be able
to give me.

Yours Faithfully,

W. Walker
Captain,
Staff Officer,
Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

GI.

D. 8257

The Commandant,
Shanghai Volunteer Corps.

M. Sokoloff and A. Hubinsky.

November 5th, 1940, the present addresses of
the above mentioned persons are as follows :-
M. Sokoloff - House 21, Lane 120, off Mikal Road.
A. Hubinsky - House 6, Lane 1315, off Yu Yuen Road.

Sd. K. M. Bourne.
Commissioner of Police.
